$schema: Ship list rendered on dummy-labs.com. Routines append entries here when SHIPPED=true. Status values: 'live' (deployed + payment-functional + public URL) | 'scaffolded' (code complete, deploy pending) | 'iterating' (post-launch improvements in flight) | 'dead' (killed).

ships.name: VibeScan
ships.description: Paste any AI-generated code and get an instant security audit. Finds real vulnerabilities — SQL injection, XSS, exposed credentials, insecure APIs — before they reach production. Built for teams shipping with AI speed.

ships.name: SecretScan
ships.tagline: Find hardcoded secrets in AI-generated code
ships.description: 60+ regex patterns + Shannon entropy analysis catch leaked API keys, tokens, and credentials. Runs 100% in your browser — your code never leaves the page.

ships.name: SlopsquatGuard
ships.tagline: Catch AI-hallucinated npm packages before install
ships.description: Scans your package.json against the live npm registry to catch slopsquatting — the attack vector exploiting LLMs that hallucinate non-existent package names. 19.7% of LLM-generated dependencies don't exist; some attackers pre-register those names with malware.

ships.name: DepShield
ships.description: Catches typosquatted dependencies, deprecated packages, and supply-chain anomalies before they enter your dependency tree. Levenshtein-distance scoring against the top 300 npm packages.
